ns2:section.sectionText: This section of TE 401 is developed by the Siebel Center for Design that will provide guidance to students in learning and building competency around the design thinking process. Have an idea? We can help you refine it through the principles of design thinking. Looking for an idea? We can walk you through the design thinking process to search for opportunity areas and help you identify specific concept directions to further explore. This is a perfect course for students looking to find great SP19 Capstone project ideas. Email siebelcenter4design@illinois.edu for more information
